import java.io.*;
import java.util.*;

public class Main {
    static final int maxn = 8;
    static final int SZ = 1048576 + 5;
    static final int MOD = 1000000007;

    static int inc(int a, int b) {
        return (a + b >= MOD) ? (a + b - MOD) : (a + b);
    }

    static int dec(int a, int b) {
        return (a >= b) ? (a - b) : (a + MOD - b);
    }

    static int mul(int a, int b) {
        return (int) ((long) a * b % MOD);
    }

    static void updata(int[] x, int y) {
        x[0] = inc(x[0], y);
    }

    static int power(int x, int k) {
        int tmp = 1;
        while (k > 0) {
            if ((k & 1) == 1) tmp = mul(tmp, x);
            x = mul(x, x);
            k >>= 1;
        }
        return tmp;
    }

    public static void main(String[] args) throws IOException {
        BufferedReader br = new BufferedReader(new InputStreamReader(System.in));
        PrintWriter pw = new PrintWriter(System.out);
        int n = Integer.parseInt(br.readLine());
        int[][] a = new int[maxn][maxn];
        int[] inv100 = new int[]{power(100, MOD - 2)};
        for (int i = 1; i <= n; i++) {
            StringTokenizer st = new StringTokenizer(br.readLine());
            for (int j = 1; j <= n; j++) {
                a[i][j] = Integer.parseInt(st.nextToken());
                a[i][j] = mul(a[i][j], inv100[0]);
            }
        }
        for (int i = n + 1; i <= 6; i++) {
            a[i][i] = 1;
        }
        int cnt = 0;
        int[][][] num = new int[7][][];
        for (int i = 1; i <= 6; i++) {
            for (int j = i + 1; j <= 6; j++) {
                for (int k = j + 1; k <= 6; k++) {
                    num[i][j][k] = 1 << cnt;
                    cnt++;
                }
            }
        }
        int all = (1 << cnt) - 1;
        int[][] g = new int[maxn][maxn];
        int[] p = new int[SZ];
        dfs1(1, 1, 1, a, g, p, num, all);
        for (int j = 0; j < cnt; j++) {
            for (int i = 0; i < (1 << cnt); i++) {
                if ((i & (1 << j)) != 0) updata(p, i, p[i ^ (1 << j)]);
            }
        }
        int Ans = 0;
        dfs2(1, 4, 1, a, g, p, num, Ans);
        Ans = dec(1, Ans);
        pw.println(Ans);
        pw.close();
    }

    static void dfs1(int now, int x, int y, int[][] a, int[][] g, int[] p, int[][][] num, int all) {
        if (x == 7) {
            int sta = 0;
            for (int i = 1; i <= 6; i++) {
                for (int j = i + 1; j <= 6; j++) {
                    for (int k = j + 1; k <= 6; k++) {
                        if (check(i, j, k)) sta |= num[i][j][k];
                    }
                }
            }
            updata(p, all ^ sta);
            return;
        }
        g[x - 3][y] = 1;
        int nxt = mul(now, a[x][y]);
        if (y == 6) dfs1(nxt, x + 1, 1, a, g, p, num, all);
        else dfs1(nxt, x, y + 1, a, g, p, num, all);
        g[x - 3][y] = 0;
        nxt = mul(now, dec(1, a[x][y]));
        if (y == 6) dfs1(nxt, x + 1, 1, a, g, p, num, all);
        else dfs1(nxt, x, y + 1, a, g, p, num, all);
    }

    static void dfs2(int now, int x, int y, int[][] a, int[][] g, int[] p, int[][][] num, int Ans) {
        if (x == 7) {
            int sta = 0;
            for (int i = 1; i <= 6; i++) {
                for (int j = i + 1; j <= 6; j++) {
                    for (int k = j + 1; k <= 6; k++) {
                        if (check(i, j, k)) sta |= num[i][j][k];
                    }
                }
            }
            updata(Ans, mul(now, p[all ^ sta]));
            return;
        }
        g[x - 3][y] = 1;
        int nxt = mul(now, a[x][y]);
        if (y == 6) dfs2(nxt, x + 1, 1, a, g, p, num, Ans);
        else dfs2(nxt, x, y + 1, a, g, p, num, Ans);
        g[x - 3][y] = 0;
        nxt = mul(now, dec(1, a[x][y]));
        if (y == 6) dfs2(nxt, x + 1, 1, a, g, p, num, Ans);
        else dfs2(nxt, x, y + 1, a, g, p, num, Ans);
    }

    static boolean check(int x, int y, int z) {
        int[] pos = new int[4];
        int[] lis = new int[4];
        lis[1] = x; lis[2] = y; lis[3] = z;
        for (int i = 1; i <= 3; i++) pos[i] = i;
        do {
            boolean flag = true;
            for (int i = 1; i <= 3; i++) {
                if (g[pos[i]][lis[i]] == 0) flag = false;
            }
            if (flag) return true;
        } while (nextPermutation(pos, 1, 3 + 1));
        return false;
    }

    static void nextPermutation(int[] array, int start, int end) {
        int i = end - 2;
        while (i >= start && array[i] >= array[i + 1]) {
            i--;
        }
        if (i < start) {
            reverse(array, start, end);
        } else {
            int j = end - 1;
            while (array[j] <= array[i]) {
                j--;
            }
            swap(array, i, j);
            reverse(array, start, i + 1);
        }
    }

    static void reverse(int[] array, int start, int end) {
        while (start < end) {
            swap(array, start, end);
            start++;
            end--;
        }
    }

    static void swap(int[] array, int i, int j) {
        int temp = array[i];
        array[i] = array[j];
        array[j] = temp;
    }
}
